 World of Warcraft: Forever is the MMORPG's biggest launch as measured by peak concurrent players 
 The highly-anticipated launch from Blizzard has been a bright spot in the Xbox portfolio.
 Imran Khan , Contributing Editor , GameDeveloper.com November 9, 2026
 schedule 1 Min Read via Blizzard Entertainment Newsbrief: World of Warcraft developer Blizzard Entertainment has reported on social media that the launch of World of Warcraft: Forever , an alternate version of the company's blockbuster MMORPG, has broken records for the game's various update and expansion launches. 
 The launch achieved the biggest launch by peak concurrent players and the highest number of returning players in the game's history. Forever goes back to the first year of the MMORPG and rebuilds new content from its foundations with things like new character races, a plan that the World of Warcraft player base seemingly finds appealing.
